title: Representation Alignment for Generation: Training Diffusion Transformers Is Easier Than You Think
role: Recipe for aligning features computed from noisy inputs to a frozen clean-data encoder with a small MLP head and patch-wise cosine similarity; the template for how a score-path encoder could be trained toward a fixed target.
reads: Hidden states h_t = f_theta(z_t) after the first 8 transformer blocks (4 for SiT-B) on the noisy SD-VAE latent (32x32x4), projected by a 3-layer MLP, against frozen DINOv2 patch features of the clean image; never the network's velocity or noise output.
trains: The whole DiT/SiT from scratch on class-conditional ImageNet 256 plus the MLP head, loss L_velocity + 0.5 * L_REPA (negative mean patch-wise cosine similarity), batch 256, AdamW lr 1e-4, 400K to 4M iterations, linear interpolant alpha_t = 1 - t, sigma_t = t.
combines: No combination of two conditions' predictions; the only comparison is projected hidden state against clean encoder feature, per patch; sampling is SDE Euler-Maruyama with 250 steps, guidance scale 1.35 (equation not printed), and Figure 4 reuses the same noise across the two models compared.
adding: not addressed; the only sum written is the velocity as alpha-dot E[x*] + sigma-dot E[eps].
noise_and_seed: No seed repeats or error bars (each FID is one number from 50,000 samples); the target is chosen to be noise-invariant, the same clean feature for every noise draw of an image.
timesteps: Only t = 0, 0.25, 0.5 measured (t = 0 clean): linear-probe top-1 about 72/66/50% with REPA and 53/59/43% vanilla, max CKNNA about 0.49/0.49/0.43 vs about 0.15 (read from Figure 7 image); nothing for the high-noise half t > 0.5.
unseen: no; generation is on the training classes, and the MS-COCO text-to-image run holds out validation captions only, with no compositional measure.
headline: FID-50K (lower is better) 7.9 for SiT-XL/2 + REPA at 400K iterations against 8.3 for vanilla SiT-XL/2 at 7M iterations, no guidance, ImageNet 256x256; with guidance interval 1.42 against 2.06 for vanilla SiT-XL/2 with guidance.
suggests: (inferred) A score-path encoder can be trained REPA-style toward a frozen text embedding with an MLP head and cosine loss, but REPA never measured semantic content at the high-noise steps where the loop's score paths start, and its noise-invariant target implies several seeds per caption should be positives.
model: SiT-XL/2, SiT-L/2, SiT-B/2, DiT-XL/2, DiT-L/2 (class-conditional ImageNet latents); MMDiT on MS-COCO
